notes.title: Demo Patch 0.0.1.3
notes.notes:
Video Settings


 Fixed an issue where the Lumen buttons were not clicking properly in video settings.
 Fixed a change when changing from Lumen to other. It now properly changes to Software Tracing even when hidden.
 Fixed a few of the settings not applying properly. For example FSR Frame Generation was always on Regardless of which button was pressed. Now buttons are equal to result.


Input Settings


 Changed default input key for unequip to Z as many keyboard players didn't have access to Quote.


Tips


 Added a new Tip at rope climb section to tell the player that you can use Alternative Use Button to have an alternate Interaction with interactables.
 Changed wording of the first pickup tip so that players have in mind the selection box.


Intro Section


 Added a new Channel to the radio so that players can use the Alternative Use Button and listen to a cursed version of the main theme.


Inventory


 Fixed an issue with the Input VHS into VHS System text popping up while in regular inventory. This was the same for Keys too.
